mapper.select: SELECT * FROM material_upload_session WHERE owner_type = #{ownerType} AND owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
SELECT * FROM material_upload_session WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_type = #{ownerType} AND owner_key = #{ownerKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE material_upload_session SET quarantine_object_version_id = #{session.quarantineObjectVersionId}, s3_etag = #{session.s3Etag}, s3_checksum_sha256 = #{session.s3ChecksumSha256}, state = #{session.state}, generation = #{session.generation}, completed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{session.id} AND state = 'CREATED' AND generation = #{expectedGeneration}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(byte_size), 0) FROM material_content_blob WHERE owner_type = #{ownerType} AND owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND status <> 'DELETED') + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(expected_size), 0) FROM material_upload_session WHERE owner_type = #{ownerType} AND owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND content_blob_id IS NULL AND (state IN ('OBJECT_VERSION_PINNED', 'PROCESSING') OR (state = 'CREATED' AND policy_expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))))

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material WHERE owner_type = #{ownerType} AND owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_upload_session WHERE owner_type = #{ownerType} AND owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND content_blob_id IS NULL AND (state IN ('OBJECT_VERSION_PINNED', 'PROCESSING') OR (state = 'CREATED' AND policy_expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))))
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO material_upload_rate_bucket (subject_type, subject_key, hour_bucket, upload_count, expires_at) VALUES (#{subjectType}, #{subjectKey}, #{hourBucket}, 0, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE material_upload_rate_bucket SET upload_count = upload_count + 1 WHERE subject_type = #{subjectType} AND subject_key = #{subjectKey} AND hour_bucket = #{hourBucket}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(upload_count), 0) FROM material_upload_rate_bucket WHERE subject_type = #{subjectType} AND subject_key = #{subjectKey} AND hour_bucket = #{hourBucket}
